title: A Trillion Is a Lot… Chuck Needs a Minute 💀

author: StarTalk
description:
How big is a trillion? Neil deGrasse Tyson and Chuck Nice put billions and trillions into perspective. How many times could a trillion dollars laid end to end wrap around the world? What was happening a trillion seconds ago? And does Elon Musk have more dollars or more brain neurons?

01:26 - A Trillion Dollars
02:16 - Neurons, GDP, and Galaxies

08:40 - More Dollars Than Neurons
